title: Linux build verification
acceptance: A native x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu cargo check --workspace --all-targets finishes with exit 0 and no warnings in WSL Ubuntu; pdfxi-app default and all-feature builds pass; PLAT-002 moves to verified.
notes: Native Linux check replaces the Windows cross-target path (ring needs a Linux C toolchain). UI-only deps are optional under the ui feature; Windows gates stay clean.
